title: Marketing Manager
mission: Bring in a steady flow of the right customers by choosing, running and measuring marketing channels.
outcomes_90_days: Write a simple marketing plan with 2 or 3 channels, a budget and goals the owner agrees on.
Launch the first campaign in each chosen channel with tracking in place.
Report leads, cost per lead and customers won each month in a one page report.
Build a content calendar for the next quarter.

criteria.name: Channel strategy
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Chooses a few channels for clear reasons, with a budget and a way to learn what works.
evidence_needed: Describes why a channel was chosen over others
Gives goals and results with real numbers
Dropped a channel that did not work
levels: 0 no evidence of channel strategy
1 names channel strategy but gives no example
2 channel strategy done with guidance or at small scale
3 channel strategy done independently with a clear result
4 channel strategy with strong results, and improved the method or taught others
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows channel strategy with real examples

criteria.name: Measuring results
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Sets up tracking, reads the numbers honestly and changes plans based on them.
evidence_needed: Names the numbers tracked and where
Example of a decision made from data
Honest about what could not be measured
levels: 0 no evidence of measuring results
1 names measuring results but gives no example
2 measuring results done with guidance or at small scale
3 measuring results done independently with a clear result
4 measuring results with strong results, and improved the method or taught others
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows measuring results with real examples

gates.question: Can the person legally work in the country of the role?

deal_breakers.description: Suggests inventing reviews, testimonials or numbers.
deal_breakers.job_related_reason: Fake proof breaks advertising law and trust.

work_sample.title: 90 day marketing plan
work_sample.brief: You get a fictional company brief (service, area, average job value, a 3 thousand dollar monthly marketing budget as a made up example, current website basics). Write a one page plan with the channels you would test, budget split, first month tasks and how you would know after 90 days whether it works.
work_sample.how_to_score: Score clear customer, reasoned channel choice, test and stop rules, tracking plan, honest assumptions, and a short realistic task list.

interview_questions.question: If you had a small budget and one hire to help, how would you pick the first channel?
good_answer_signs: Starts from the customer and cost to test
Names how they would stop a bad test

interview_questions.question: Tell me about a campaign that failed. What did the numbers tell you and what did you change?
good_answer_signs: Names real numbers and a decision

interview_questions.question: How do you know leads are good and not only many?
good_answer_signs: Joint definition with sales and follow up tracking

red_flags: Only vanity numbers such as followers or impressions
Cannot say what any campaign cost
Promises results with no way to measure
Talks about tools but not customers
sourcing_channels: Referrals from owners in noncompeting businesses
Portfolios and case studies on personal sites
Freelance marketers who may become full time
pay_research_hint: Check current postings for marketing managers in your region and a published pay survey. Compare in house pay with freelance day rates to see which path suits your budget.
automation_note: AI can draft copy, research competitors, report numbers and run first drafts of calendars. A person should set the strategy, approve claims and spend, and own brand tone.
